instruction: Candid cinematic medium shot of two men walking on an outdoor path surrounded by dense green foliage. On the left, the man in the gray hoodie (R1) is shown from the chest up, turning his head to laugh and look at his companion. On the right, the bald man in the white shirt (R2), wearing sunglasses on his head, walks forward with a warm smile. The two walk closely side-by-side, sharing a friendly moment. Soft, natural daylight filters through the trees, creating a warm, relaxed atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
